pattern-note: causation chains staged as domino runs on a walnut table
palette: 胡桃木桌台 felt + 米白骨牌 domino + 漆红点位 lacquer + 推杆橙 pusher + 松石青 teal
typography: heavy run-log headings, square domino chips, pointed label blocks, double-frame verdict tiles
composition: each scene lays a domino run: the cause gate checks the first tile, the effect gate checks the last tile, the fork splits abnormality and weight, and the fog board hides the fallen order
surface: felt table grain, square pale tiles, dashed independent-relation routes, double-frame verdict tiles; no glossy panels
motion: tiles enter along the run in reasoning order, fork gates split the path, verdict tiles land at the attribution point; no idle loops
transition: the table felt and tile row persist while each scene re-lays the run
